reason: A hot chocolate with torched meringue or a cherry pie matcha is exactly the kind of drink I'd stop for on a weekend walk and post. I'd try one or two of the signature drinks, but at $7.50 I'm not making it a weekly habit unless it actually looks and tastes as good as it sounds.
objection: No drip coffee, so if I just want a quick black coffee it's slower, and I don't know yet if these drinks look good enough on camera to justify $7.50 over the places I already go.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing photos of the drinks first, especially the torched meringue, so I know they're worth the trip and the price.
